caption:
The villa, on plan.

The rooms you have followed here, seen from above: on the ground floor the living room, the dining room and the guest bedroom; upstairs the lounge and the master bedroom. Every render starts here, with a plan drawn to the centimetre.

Swipe to see both floors, the dimensioned plan and our first notes on it.
